references.text: The priest goes out to examine and assess the condition, parallel to the priest's inspection of the house after it has been scraped.
The priest returns to examine whether the plague has spread, following the same pattern as in verse 48.
The priest examines whether the plague has spread in the house, contrasting with verse 48 where the plague had not spread.
The priest declares the person clean when the plague has not spread; the same principle is applied to the house.
The priest declares the afflicted person clean because the plague has been healed, parallel to the healing of the house's plague.
The conclusion of the cleansing ritual for the house, which follows the priest's declaration that the house is clean.
